author: MrBig2027
quote:
I am at a loss for words at the product Rockstar Games put on the digital shelves.
I was already sceptical that the current developers working at rockstar lost sense of what makes a GTA game when the first official reveal came and we saw the main characters were a couple. And now that the game is out,I can confirm. GTA VI is an insult to both the fans who have played and have grown up alongside past iterations of GTA,but also a slap to the proverbial face to the developers and people who helped develop the previous titles in the franchise. I cannot recommend this game nor say there is enough enjoyable content in for any GTA **** you have never played a game from this franchise and do not mind a game that was only made as a cash-grab title banking on the popular name of GTA then by all means attempt to enjoy this game.This reviewer has certainly not done the same.
